stb_image.h: Sean Barrett's image loader, v2.30 (github.com/nothings/stb, the file as of commit
013ac3beddff3dbffafd5177e7972067cd2b5083), unchanged. Public domain or MIT, as its end says.
Used only to read the games' art (art/*.jpg, built into the program by tools/embed_art.py).

xbrz/: xBRZ 1.8 by Zenju (GPLv3, see xbrz/License.txt), from https://sourceforge.net/projects/xbrz/ : the HD FILTER.
